name: computer-use
description: Bundled Windows Computer Use MCP server for Codex App Plus.

interface.longDescription: Computer Use for Windows lets Codex inspect and control desktop apps through a local MCP server. It uses a persistent PowerShell UI Automation worker, then Win32 window messages as fallback input when an app does not expose semantic actions. You stay in control: app access can require explicit approvals in CODEX_HOME/computer-use/config.toml, protected high-risk apps are blocked by default, sensitive UI text is redacted from snapshots, screenshots are omitted when sensitive fields are present, and risky UI actions are blocked before input is sent.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the current UI state of a running Windows app before acting
Use element-targeted interactions before coordinate clicks
Type into Notepad and verify the updated app state
